say.speaker: partner
say.text: Uh, guys? Is that a Slakoth napping right in the middle of the meadow while poachers close in?!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Do not let that drowsy posture fool you. Youngsters like Slakoth start slow, yet they grow far stronger than anyone expects once they start fighting.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Let's hurry across the grass, rouse Slakoth before the poachers reach him, and clear them out of this meadow!
